title: Critique: other neuron types may carry conscious access

statements.text: Early versions of global neuronal workspace theory placed conscious access in layer 2/3 pyramidal cells with long-range connections rather than in layer 5 neurons, and many other neuron types form cortical microcircuits whose intricacy is easily underestimated.

sources.quote: L2/3 pyramidal cells with long-range connections (not L5 neurons as in DIT) are most crucial for AC
Besides the large L5 neurons highlighted in DIT, multiple neuron types connected by millions of synapses form immensely complex microcircuits
